en: Old monochrome (blue‑tinted) postcard showing a church with twin domed towers and a simple façade facing an open square with trees and a bench. Below the image is printed text identifying the scene as a church in Quelimane, Mozambique. The right half of the card is filled with handwritten French text, and a date and place (Lisbonne, 17 janvier 1902) appear at the top right.
